newsitem.title: FRANCE: Credit Agricole to get all of Indosuez on Dec 23.
newsitem.headline: Credit Agricole to get all of Indosuez on Dec 23.

text.p: French bank Caisse Nationale de Credit Agricole and financial holding Compagnie de Suez said on Saturday Credit Agricole would take full control of merchant bank Banque Indosuez on December 23.
They said they had agreed to speed up a deal originally concluded in May and Credit Agricole would pay the remaining takeover price on Monday.
The companies said that an audit ended at June 30 this year showed that the value of Indosuez was 11.790 billion francs.
Credit Agricole will pay a total price of 11.9 billion francs which includes 6.3 billion francs already paid in May for 51 percent of the diluted share capital.
Compagnie de Suez said the transaction would lead to a capital gain of 300 million francs in its accounts for the year ending December 31.
